body:
maria: Ran the AWQ vs GPTQ bakeoff across A100 nodes and hit intermittent segfaults only in the TensorRT-LLM path when serving AWQ-quantized weights. Repro steps + small logs below. Anyone seen anything like this? :thinking:

 dmitri: What CUDA + driver + TRT combo did you use? paste the exact log snippet please.

 maria: Env: CUDA 12.2, NVIDIA driver 535.54, TensorRT-LLM custom (trt 8.5), vLLM 0.8, awq commit 4f2b3a. Model: ~13B Mistral-ish, AWQ int8 (per-channel scales), infer batch_size=8, continuous batching enabled. Log:
 ```
 2025-08-02 14:12:03,412 trtllm ERROR: cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid configuration argument
 terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
   what():  CUDNN_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED
 signal 11 (SIGSEGV), fault addr 0x7ff... in cuLaunchKernel
 ```

 ashwin: We've seen similar when FP8/INT8 kernels are mixed in TRT and driver JIT emits incompatible ptx. Quick try: force TRT OFF FP8 kernels (env TRT_FORCE_FP8=0 or --trt-disable-fp8-kernels) to see if the kernel selection is the culprit.

 maria: Tried TRT_FORCE_FP8=0 — crash still happens but different stack (looks like workspace OOM):
 ```
 E tensorflow: failed to allocate workspace: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
 #0 0x7fbd... in trtllm::Workspace::alloc
 #1 0x7fbd... in trtllm::Op::execute
 ```
 Forcing non-FP8 shifts failure mode from segfault to allocation failure.

 jen: assigning to infra to reproduce in CI. @dmitri can you spin up a small matrix: cuda 12.1 / 12.2 / 12.4 and drivers 535 vs 540, trt 8.4/8.5/8.6? Need to narrow driver/kernel coupling. :mag:

 dmitri: on it. I'll also test with continuous batching on/off in our runtime. If vLLM+Triton path passes but trtllm fails, it's likely a TRT plugin/kernel issue. maria, can you confirm vLLM results?

 maria: vLLM + Triton path is stable in my runs (no segfaults), only trtllm path flaps under concurrent requests. Failure rate increases with >=4 concurrent requests.

 ashwin: hypothesis: AWQ per-channel scales + batched KV cache + mixed-precision TRT kernels -> workspace reuse or race leading to scratch corruption. Short-term workaround: disable continuous batching for trtllm or set max_batch_size=1 for the affected routes.

 dmitri: repro script: spawn 1000 concurrent infer requests (batch_size=8) and I reproduce ~30% crash rate on my A100 node. I'll run the driver/TRT matrix and collect coredumps, nvprof traces, and cupti timelines. Also will try pinning libcudnn/cuDNN runtime in the container.

 maria: posted perf dashboard and small eval diffs: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/quant-bakeoff/1953
 Note: AWQ vs GPTQ LAMBADA delta ~ -0.6% (AWQ slightly worse) under these quant params; AWQ gives cost savings so we'd like to keep it if runtime can be stabilized.

 ci-bot: issue #1423 created: "trtllm: intermittent segfaults with AWQ on CUDA12.x - reproduce/triage" linked to run 1957123456.

 ashwin: next steps: infra runs driver/TRT permutations + disable batching; ML will do a tiny bisect over AWQ quant params (per-channel vs per-tensor, block size) to see correlation. We'll reconvene after dmitri posts cross-matrix results.
